title: Knobby Dense Japanese Pinto Bean Ramen
description: A traditional Japanese Kanto dish featuring pinto beans and score-fat, this recipe is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and perfect for midnight cravings. It has a yeasty and dense flavor profile.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the soaked and drained pinto beans, score-fat, and 4 cups of water, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until the beans are tender.
In a separate pot, combine the ramen noodles and 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 3 minutes, or until the noodles are cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the shoyu sauce, mirin, and sesame oil to make the seasoning sauce.
Add the seasoning sauce to the pot with the pinto beans and stir to combine.
Add the cooked ramen noodles to the pot with the pinto beans and stir to combine.
Add the kombu seaweed to the pot and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the seaweed is rehydrated.
Stir in the yeast extract and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the ramen hot, garnished with green onions.
